headline: Rapid Valley Annihilation: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Rapid Valley Annihilation is projected #13 of 16 with a 545.40 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Colston Loveland, Quinshon Judkins, and Caleb Williams. The immediate priority is improving the FLEX slot without weakening that core. On the website's D-AVI ladder, the franchise ranks #11 of 16 with a 745.9 dynasty power score.
